propositions: Cloud test coverage lacks positive assertions for the empty-assignee unassign behavior that DC tests pin in test_dc_unassign_751e.py, creating regression risk
AcliClient.update_issue must route assignee in (None, "") to unassign_issue instead of forwarding to ACLI as --assignee "", which silently no-ops
New test suite verifies that update_issue(key, assignee="") and update_issue(key, assignee=None) both call unassign_issue exactly once with no workitem edit subprocess spawned
Co-submit case test asserts update_issue(key, assignee="", summary="new summary") calls unassign_issue once and emits workitem edit argv with --summary but no --assignee flag
Non-empty assignee must still take the validate-then-edit path without invoking unassign_issue and with --assignee present in argv
